mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_evidence_ref(evidence_id, requirement_id, case_subject_id, file_address, content_hash, document_type, issue_date, expiry_date, status, reject_reason_code, review_note, reviewer_id, reviewed_time, reused_from_case_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.evidenceId}, #{row.requirementId}, #{row.caseSubjectId}, #{row.fileAddress}, #{row.contentHash}, #{row.documentType}, #{row.issueDate}, #{row.expiryDate}, #{row.status}, #{row.rejectReasonCode}, #{row.reviewNote}, #{row.reviewerId}, #{row.reviewedTime}, #{row.reusedFromCaseId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT e.evidence_id AS evidenceId, e.requirement_id AS requirementId, e.case_subject_id AS caseSubjectId, e.file_address AS fileAddress, e.content_hash AS contentHash, e.document_type AS documentType, e.issue_date AS issueDate, e.expiry_date AS expiryDate, e.status, e.reject_reason_code AS rejectReasonCode, e.review_note AS reviewNote, e.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, e.reviewed_time AS reviewedTime, e.reused_from_case_id AS reusedFromCaseId, e.version, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM t_dd_evidence_ref e JOIN t_dd_requirement r ON r.requirement_id = e.requirement_id WHERE r.case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY e.requirement_id, e.evidence_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dd_evidence_ref SET status = #{status}, reject_reason_code = #{rejectReasonCode}, review_note = #{note}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_time = #{now}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE evidence_id = #{row.evidenceId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'RECEIVED'
